title: Design brief
description: The first design brief for one intent, written when Discover closes and accepted before Design starts. It is the direction prototyping starts from and the benchmark the prototypes, the form and the spec are judged against. It is drawn from what Discover produced -- the accepted intent, the workshop's close when cornerstone ran, and the UI/UX goals -- and every statement names the line it comes from. What those documents do not answer is an open question for the operator, never a filled-in guess. The second design brief (doc type brief) is drawn from the prototypes afterwards.

intent.description: Id of the intent document the brief serves
